title: Welcome to OpenNotion
body:
# What this is
A notes + tasks board stored as plain parquet snapshots on your own disk.

- Click a row to open it and write notes
- Every edit writes a new snapshot, so nothing is ever overwritten
- Open the table menu to see the full history, or to move the lake elsewhere

These demo rows are seeded on first run. Delete them and they stay deleted.

title: Draft the weekly review
body:
## Sections
- [ ] What shipped
- [ ] What slipped, and why
- [ ] One number that moved

> Keep it to a single screen.

title: Try the CLI on this same data
body:
The UI and `lakectl.py` share one lake:

- `lakectl.py tables`
- `lakectl.py rows tasks`
- `lakectl.py add tasks --set title="From the CLI" --set status=prog

Reload the page and the new row is there.

title: Snapshot history is the undo button
body: Nothing is mutated in place. Every write drops a new timestamped parquet file, so any past state of the table can be read back.
